docs.title: Powers
docs.text:
Here you can find all the relevant information regarding the different Power types of the addon:

  • Main Powers

docs.title: Main Powers
docs.text:
"Main Powers" is a term used to describe powers obtainable that cannot be stacked with each other. Most of these powers can be paired with Secondary Powers but no two main powers can be paired with each other naturally. The main powers within the addon currently are :

  • Marvel
  • DC

docs.title: DC
docs.text:
DC powers possess a wide range of extraordinary abilities, originating from diverse sources such as alien biology, metahuman genetics, advanced technology, magic, and cosmic forces. Their powers vary greatly, including superhuman strength, enhanced senses, energy manipulation, elemental control, and other unique abilities. Here you can find all the information and list of DC powers.

  • Kryptonians
  • Metahumans

docs.title: Kryptonians
docs.text:
Kryptonians are a humanoid extraterrestrial species originating from the planet Krypton. Under a yellow sun, they develop extraordinary abilities, including superhuman strength, speed, flight, enhanced senses, and near-invulnerability. Their powers vary depending on their individual traits, exposure to different solar levels, and the universe they originate from. Here you can find all the variants and information regarding them.

  • Absolute

docs.title: Metahumans
docs.text:
Metahumans are individuals in the DC Universe who possess extraordinary abilities, often resulting from genetic mutations, metagene activation, or exposure to unusual energies and substances. Their powers vary widely, including superhuman strength, enhanced senses, elemental control, energy manipulation, technology control, and other unique abilities.

  • Technopaty

docs.title: Marvel
docs.text:
Marvel characters possess a wide range of extraordinary abilities, often gained through genetic mutations, scientific experiments, advanced technology, exposure to radiation, or other supernatural and cosmic phenomena. Their powers vary greatly, including superhuman strength, enhanced senses, energy manipulation, elemental control, and a variety of unique abilities. Here you can find all the information about powers from Marvel.

  • Mutants
  • Arachnids

docs.title: Arachnids
docs.text:
Arachnids are individuals who possess spider-like abilities, typically gained through exposure to radioactive or genetically altered spiders. Their powers commonly include enhanced strength, speed, agility, wall-crawling, and a spider-sense that warns them of danger. Depending on the individual, they may also possess unique abilities such as organic webbing, venom blasts, camouflage, or enhanced biological traits. Here you can find all the informaiton about arachnid powers.

  • Peter Parker
  • Miles Morales
  • Miguel O'hara

docs.title: Mutants
docs.text:
Mutants are individuals in the Marvel Universe who possess the X-gene, a genetic trait that grants them extraordinary abilities, often manifesting during adolescence or periods of extreme stress. Their powers vary widely, ranging from enhanced physical abilities and elemental manipulation to telepathy, shapeshifting, and reality warping.

  • Reality Warping

docs.title: Reality Warping
docs.text:
Main Power · Marvel · Mutants Reality Warping Obtained fromX-Generandom chance Ability slots12345Psionic · Energy · Spatial · Reality · Cosmic Signature lookBlue energyBeams, Projectiles and more

Reality Warping is a powerful ability that allows the user to manipulate and reshape reality, drawing on psionic, energy, spatial, reality, and cosmic powers. It grants abilities such as telepathy, telekinesis, energy projection, dimensional travel, matter alteration, and environmental transformation, making it an extremely versatile power with both offensive and defensive capabilities.

docs.title: Abilities
docs.text:
Reality Warping has five ability slots. Jump to one:

Psionic Manipulation Energy Manipulation Dimensional Manipulation Reality Manipulation Cosmic Manipulation

docs.title: Psionic Manipulation
docs.text: Use your Telephaty or Telekinesis via various methods.

docs.title: Psionic Strike
docs.text:
Directly attack a target's mind within 6 blocks. This will deal -4 Psionic damage to the target when hit.

Range 6 blocksDamage -4 Psionic

docs.title: Psionic Read
docs.text:
Use your telepathic reach to reveal the information of Entities around you in a 30 block radius. If you are using Cerebro to enhance your abilities, you will also be able to read any powers targets in range have.

Radius 30 blocks

docs.title: Psionic Sight
docs.text:
Use your telepathic reach to see through another target's eyes. You will be able to hop up to 3 times into different targets.

Hops up to 3

docs.title: Telekinetic Hold
docs.text:
Telekinetically grab any entity or block within 8 blocks of you. Scrolling while this is enabled will allow you to bring the target closer or further.

Range 8 blocks

docs.title: Telekinetic Repulsion
docs.text:
Telekinetically repel all targets within 3 blocks of you away from you.

Radius 3 blocks

docs.title: Telekinetic Barrage
docs.text:
Lift, then launch up to 5 blocks within a 6 block radius of you at your target for 4 damage per hit.

Blocks up to 5Radius 6 blocksDamage 4 per hit

docs.title: Energy Manipulation
docs.text: Use your power to manipulate different energies in various ways.

docs.title: Reality Conversion (Multiversal)
docs.text: Dip into your ability to rewrite reality to convert any item in your mainhand into its multiversal counterpart, if it has any.

docs.title: Reality Conversion (Store)
docs.text: Use some of your energy to register items within your mental database. This will consume the item being registered, and will not retain any enchantments / nbt data. Items entered in the Argon mod's config file blacklist cannot be saved for creation.

docs.title: Reality Conversion (Create)
docs.text:
Use some of your energy to create items within your mental database. Once registered, each item has a max of 5 times it can be created before needing to be re-registered in your mental database.

Creates per registration 5

docs.title: Energy Beam
docs.text: Manipulate your energy to fire off a beam of raw reality energy.

docs.title: Energy Shield
docs.text:
Manipulate your energy to create a shield of raw reality energy in front of you. With this shield, you will be able to block up to 50 damage in front of you before it breaks.

Blocks up to 50 damage

docs.title: Energy Explosion
docs.text:
Manipulate the energy inside you by charging it up for 5 seconds, then exploding it out of you harming everything within a 5 block radius of you.

Charge 5 secondsRadius 5 blocks

docs.title: Spatial Manipulation
docs.text: Use your power to manipulate the space around you, and gain mastery over it.

docs.title: Spatial Travel (Short)
docs.text:
Fold the distance between you and a location up to 15 blocks in the direction you are looking to appear there instantly.

Distance up to 15 blocks

docs.title: Pocket Dimension: Storage
docs.text:
Tap into the power of your Pocket Dimension to store up to 32 items in a controlled space that only you have access to.

Capacity 32 items

docs.title: Pocket Dimension: Travel
docs.text: Create a small portal to send yourself to your Pocket Dimension. Using this ability while in the Pocket Dimension will return you to where you were when you left.

docs.title: Spatial Travel (Multiversal)
docs.text: Gain the ability to open a menu to create portals that allow you and others to travel throughout different dimensions.

docs.title: Reality Manipulation
docs.text: Use your power to shape and manipulate the reality around you.

docs.title: Reconstruction
docs.text: Using the item(s) in your mainhand, convert it into anything that uses it as a crafting material. You will need the amount of said item used in that attempted item's crafting recipe to reconstruct it.

docs.title: State Changer
docs.text: Alter the reality of a targeted block to change the blockstate of any block you are looking at between any of its available states.

docs.title: Compact
docs.text: Select an area to alter into a compact item. Placing the item on a block will return it to its full size.

docs.title: Biome Shift
docs.text:
Transform reality around you in a 12 block radius to that of a random biome. Those who are caught in the dome with you will not be able to escape / break any blocks until the ability is released. Based on the biome you changed to, have the following effects granted to all within the altered reality:

Radius 12 blocks Plains RegenerationDesert HungerSnowy Taiga FreezeDripstone Caves Fire resistanceDeep Dark BlindnessNether Wastes BurningSoul Sand Valley WitherBasalt Deltas WeaknessEnd Barrens Saturation

docs.title: Cosmic Manipulation
docs.text: Use your power to manipulate the Power Cosmic around you.

docs.title: Cosmic Conduit
docs.text:
Enter a meditative state to passively pull in Cosmic energy from around you to rapidly regenerate your reality energy bar, and create a light source around you. You will not be able to move, and your flight speed will be reduced by 90% while this ability is enabled, and you will also take 2x damage from all sources.

Flight speed -90%Damage taken 2x

docs.title: Cosmic Herald
docs.text: At the cost of a significant amount of your stored energy, grant the target you are looking at the Cosmic Awakening effect which can grant them access to the abilities of your Cosmic Herald.

docs.title: Cosmic Resonance
docs.text:
Drain your Reality Energy to grant the Regeneration, Resistance and Strength effects on all Heralds within a 20 block radius. This will also grant the Wither Effect to all non-heralds within a 10 block radius.

Heralds 20 blocksNon-heralds 10 blocks

docs.title: Cosmic Energy Surge
docs.text:
Drain your Reality Energy to slow all targets within a 5 block radius around you, using your Cosmic Energy to deal damage to them over time.

Radius 5 blocks

docs.title: Relevant Information
docs.text:
• This power is loosely based on Franklin Richards, a.k.a. Powerhouse.
  • Cerebro gives buffs to telepathic abilities when worn.
  • This power is one of the two powers that can travel other dimensions.

There are 4 abilities that add boosts to you when you are in the Pocket Dimension:

Pocket Dimension: Healing+1 heart / 2 secs Pocket Dimension: Health+6 hp Pocket Dimension: Energy+30 energy / sec Pocket Dimension: Saturation+1 saturation / 3 secs
